newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Natanyahu says Mideast peace not doomed.
newsitem.headline: Natanyahu says Mideast peace not doomed.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended internationally criticised plans to build Jewish housing in Arab East Jerusalem on Tuesday, but said disagreement does not doom the Middle East peace process.

"This kind of doomsday talk and the whole histrionic attitude towards obvious disagreement is itself not conducive to the (peace) process," he told a news conference with Russia's Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov.
"We have disagreements. We cannot at every stage of this agreement engage in cataclysmic predictions and talk of crisis and violence," he said.
"The important thing is we keep our side of the agreement. We expect the Palestinians to keep theirs and they haven't."
Israeli-Palestinian relations have worsened in recent weeks following an Israeli decision earlier this month to build 6,500 housing units in Arab East Jerusalem.
